content: WebAuthn Conditional Mediation (autocomplete=webauthn on username field) requires feature-detecting via typeof PublicKeyCredential.isConditionalMediationAvailable === 'function' then awaiting it, before offering passkey-autofill UI -- support is broad on Chrome/Edge/Safari/Firefox but OS/platform-dependent (Win11+/Mac/Android) and inconsistent enough that a fallback path is required. Not the same mechanism as this phase's password/TOTP/card content-relay fill (which is our own UI-driven fill, not the platform's native credential autofill), but confirms autocomplete tokens are the standardized signal family this phase's D-05/D-06 heuristics should key off.
